contents.desc: 8 deaths in 4 years. A $4.2M CEO payout. Toxic chemical exposure. Intrusive surveillance.
Cleanaway workers have officially had ENOUGH and they are taking a stand.

From mother-of-seven Hine Murphy suffering permanent vision loss from toxic exposure, to union inspectors finding improperly disposed biohazards on site floors, Cleanaway’s workplace safety record is a national disgrace.
While CEO Mark Schubert took home $4.2 million last financial year, the company continues to reject fair pay and decent working conditions
❌ Ignore critical safety training required by regulators
❌ Push intrusive surveillance technology on workers without proper consultation
❌ Put profits over human lives
Now, union members are fighting back. Transport Workers Union (TWU) members at the Dandenong site in Victoria have voted UNANIMOUSLY to take protected industrial action.
We were flooded with over 35 horror stories from former employees and the public; from 16-hour workdays to terrifying road near-misses.
No worker should ever have to risk their life just to earn a living.
Stand together for safe workplaces. If you work in waste management or any industry taking advantage of workers, join your union today. Link in bio to join.
#AustralianUnions #Cleanaway #TWU #AMWU #AWU #TransportWorkersUnion #WorkplaceSafety
